g.text: Jev Auto: execution chosen per subtask
Median, min–max of successful attempts, and successes / all attempts. Gemini 3.8 Flash / low. 119 comparison attempts.
Each panel uses its own zero-based scale. Time includes verification, excludes setup. Local n=3; Flights n=5.
The credit-interrupted block (18 attempts) is retained separately. Small samples do not establish reliability across the web.
